user.title: Connect an RF bridge
user.description: Pick the ESPHome node running the rf_cloner component. Its learned commands become Home Assistant entities.

data_description.esphome_entry_id: The node that carries the bridge. It must be connected.
data_description.action_prefix: Only change this if the node's rf_cloner actions were given a prefix other than rf_.

reconfigure.title: Move this bridge to another node
reconfigure.description: Point this bridge at a different ESPHome node. If the node is replacement hardware, you will be offered a restore.

data_description.esphome_entry_id: The node that now carries this bridge.
data_description.action_prefix: Only change this if the node's rf_cloner actions were given a prefix other than rf_.

replace.title: Restore onto replacement hardware
replace.description: This node is empty and reports a different identity ({found_bridge_id}). Restoring writes {commands} command(s) back onto it as bridge {bridge_id}, keeping every command id so your dashboards and automations keep working. Your RF devices and the commands assigned to them are kept as they are.

error.cannot_connect: The node did not answer. Check that it is online and running the rf_cloner component.
error.no_bridge_actions: That node exposes no rf_cloner actions. Check that it includes packages/api-actions.yaml and is connected.
error.esphome_entry_missing: That ESPHome device no longer exists.

abort.already_configured: This bridge is already set up.
abort.reconfigure_successful: The bridge now uses the selected node.
abort.restore_successful: The bridge was restored onto the replacement hardware.
abort.no_snapshot: There is no snapshot to restore. Home Assistant has never read a complete copy of this bridge's commands.
abort.restore_not_possible: This node cannot be restored onto: {detail}.

init.title: RF commands
init.description: Learn a new command, or change one this bridge already has.

learn_command.title: Learn a command
learn_command.description: Name the command and choose the RF device it belongs to, then hold the button on your remote when asked. Letters, digits, underscore, hyphen and full stop only, up to 23 characters.

data_description.name: Stored on the bridge, so it is also what the bridge's own web page shows.
data_description.target_id: Which piece of equipment this command drives. Leave it unassigned if you would rather not group it.
data_description.icon: Optional. Left empty, one is suggested from the name and the device type.

manage_command.title: Choose a command
manage_command.description: Pick the command to edit or delete. The RF device it currently belongs to is shown in brackets.

command.title: Edit {name}
command.description: Renaming changes the name stored on the bridge. Changing the RF device or the icon changes nothing on the bridge: the command keeps its identity, its waveform and its history either way.

data.name: Name
data.delete: Delete this command from the bridge

data_description.name: Letters, digits, underscore, hyphen and full stop only, up to 23 characters.
data_description.target_id: Move the command to another RF device, or to Unassigned.
data_description.icon: An icon you set on the entity itself takes precedence over this one.
data_description.delete: Tick to go on to a confirmation. Nothing is deleted from this screen.

confirm_delete.title: Delete {name}?
confirm_delete.description:
This erases the command "{name}" from the bridge, waveform and all. It cannot be undone, and only a snapshot restore would bring it back. The button and its history are removed with it.

Removing an RF device does none of this: it only ungroups its commands.

error.name_too_long: That name is longer than 23 characters.
error.name_invalid: Use only letters, digits, underscore, hyphen and full stop.
error.name_taken: This bridge already has a command with that name.

progress.learning: Press and hold the button on your remote now to teach it "{name}".

abort.not_loaded: The bridge is not ready yet. Try again once it has connected.
abort.not_writable: The bridge is not accepting changes right now.
abort.registry_full: The bridge has no free command slots left.
abort.no_commands: This bridge has not learned any commands yet.
abort.unknown_command: That command is no longer on the bridge.

user.title: Add an RF device
user.description: Describe the equipment this bridge drives - a ceiling fan, a gate, a projector. Its commands then appear together, as one device in Home Assistant.

data_description.name: What you call the equipment, for example Bedroom Fan.
data_description.target_type: Presentation only. It suggests icons and labels; it does not add fan or cover controls.
data_description.area_id: Where the equipment is. Applied when the device is created; you can move it afterwards.

reconfigure.title: Edit RF device
reconfigure.description: Renaming or retyping an RF device changes nothing on the bridge. Its commands keep their identity, their waveforms and their history.

data_description.name: What you call the equipment, for example Bedroom Fan.
data_description.target_type: Presentation only. It suggests icons and labels; it does not add fan or cover controls.
data_description.area_id: Only applied when the device is first created. A later move of your own is never overwritten.

error.target_name_taken: This bridge already has an RF device with that name.

abort.unknown_target: This RF device's configuration is unreadable.
abort.already_configured: This RF device is already set up.

learn.name: Learn command
learn.description: Captures a command from a remote and stores it on the bridge. Waits for the capture to finish.

name.name: Name
name.description: Letters, digits, underscore, hyphen and full stop only, up to 23 characters.

cancel_learn.name: Cancel learning
cancel_learn.description: Disarms a capture that is waiting for a button press.

export_snapshot.name: Export snapshot
export_snapshot.description: Returns Home Assistant's restorable copy of the bridge's commands, waveforms included.

config_entry_id.name: Bridge
config_entry_id.description: The bridge whose snapshot to return.

esphome_entry_missing.message: The ESPHome device this bridge was set up against no longer exists.

name_empty.message: Enter a name for the command.

name_too_long.message: "{name}" is longer than the 23 characters the bridge stores.

name_invalid.message: "{name}" may only contain letters, digits, underscore, hyphen and full stop.

no_snapshot.message: Home Assistant has no snapshot of {title} yet.
